description: The authors propose an assessment sequence in which students first complete an FTE task to collect a vocabulary for a subject, then receive a battery of TPTE tasks prompted by terms from their own FTE responses.
title: Combine FTE with Term Prompted Term Entry tasks to build detailed maps of students' conceptual knowledge structure

description: The final FTW session has the whole group produce a set of requirements for each model, described to participants as \"the set of instructions they would give to an engineer who would be willing to implement the model\".
title: Requirements session in which participants directly list and rate requirements for future technology
